title: 1898 Baloch uprising
summary: The English Wikipedia article "1898 Baloch uprising", at revision 1366266518, opens: "The 1898 Baloch uprising was a revolt that occurred in Balochistan, modern-day Pakistan. It was instigated by Sardar Mehrab Khan Gichki and Mir Baloch Khan Nousherwani." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q4557264, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "Pakistani revolt". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
